motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses the frame: mantis, fly, wrap, box or camera; never a second where only the mouth moves; gestures wide, the shot size always changing
character: a praying mantis, green-brown, huge amber eyes, spined raptorial arms
cast: one fat fly with a straw mic, huge at the lens, never speaking; it drops the straw and flies off
props: one box: taped shut, slit, empty, then shut from inside; ONE sheet of bubble wrap, tape, a label with no letters
must_appear: required, not errors: her pictogram on the label, and one big mantis foreleg, larger than his, not the fly's, on the lid at 9.3
environment: a gravel doorstep in an empty yard
lighting: hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right, deep shadows, high contrast

light_events.event: sun flares white off the wrap
a blade of light narrows through the closing gap
a wide shadow sweeps over the closed box

fly_passes: the fly crosses the whole frame at the lens at 0.9, 2.0, 3.4, 4.6, 8.9, never hovering
lip_sync: mouthparts open and close on every syllable, sharp articulation

audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 130 Hz, 4.2 syllables per second
audio.pacing: no pause inside a sentence, endings voiced, nothing after 6.0

timeline.a: silent. A box slams into the gravel, dust bursting over the lens
timeline.c: macro on his face, camera jolts

timeline.a: spoken fast, sentence runs on; he heaves the box onto its side and shoves it grinding at us
same sentence, no pause; he slams the box label-first into the lens and climbs on the lid
silent. His arm shoots across the frame and slits the tape end to end
timeline.c: whip to macro on the seam

timeline.a: spoken fast; he spins the box, the pictogram sweeping past the lens
silent. He throws both flaps open at the camera, wrap bursting out
spoken fast, sentence runs on; he rips the wrap up out of the box
same sentence, no pause, last word voiced; he snaps it open over the empty bottom
silent from here on. He flings that same sheet over the lens, it drops back into the box
timeline.c: the wrap swallows the lens, one shot

timeline.a: he vaults over the rim onto the fallen wrap and smooths it flat under him
timeline.c: top-down into the box, closing in

timeline.a: he swings both flaps shut over himself
he drags the tape over the seam, a bubble pops under him
his thin leg comes out of the gap and presses the tape flat
the fly drops the straw and blasts past the lens
a big foreign foreleg, larger than his, drops on the lid; the label faces us

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, pause in the middle of a sentence, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, letters on the label, English speech, foreign accent, static camera, locked-off shots, floating objects, duplicate props, object duplication, extra limbs on the mantis, character changing appearance mid-shot
